topics.definition: Routing is the process of forwarding packets between different networks.
Switching transfers data between devices within the same local network.
A routing table stores network paths used by routers.
tips: Routing tables are updated automatically or manually.

topics.definition: Static routing uses manually configured routes.
tips: Simple but difficult to maintain in large networks.

topics.definition: Dynamic routing automatically updates routes using routing protocols.
tips: Suitable for large and changing networks.

topics.definition: A bridge connects two LAN segments and filters traffic using MAC addresses.
tips: Bridges operate at the Data Link layer.

topics.definition: Routers connect different networks using IP addresses, while switches connect devices within the same network using MAC addresses.
tips: Routers work at Layer 3, switches mainly at Layer 2.

topics.definition: Use efficient routing protocols, secure network devices and monitor network traffic.
